name: Gongpoquansaurus
sum: A basal hadrosauroid of the Albian of Gansu, China, formally named in 2014 after years as a nomen nudum.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: IVPP V.11333, a partial skull and postcranial skeleton.
biology: Not described in the sources consulted.
